prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph down the narrow aisle of a small British corner shop late at night. Cold fluorescent tubes wash everything a sickly teal; the rest of the shop is crammed with cheap snacks and tins, but one shelf at eye level is completely bare, with a small handwritten card taped to its edge reading "SORRY, SOLD OUT" in biro capitals. A lone shopper in a worn parka stands in front of it, seen only from behind, shoulders slightly dropped. At the far end of the aisle, a plain back-room door stands a few inches ajar, dark beyond. Shot on Cinestill 800T, pronounced grain, slight halation on the tubes, cheap compact flash off, lonely and quietly eerie. Thanks.
